blurb: Guests parasail from a 31-foot US Coast Guard certified boat over the Atlantic Ocean, enjoying panoramic views of New Jersey's beaches and coastline. Flights include options to stay dry, dip gently, or do a full water dunk. Photo and video packages are available to capture the experience.
extraNote: Safety is our highest priority and the Captain will make all decisions regarding safe operation for all activities, including weather or any particular configuration in the number of guests participating. · Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. · Weather related cancellations are determined by the management and are 100% refundable. · Cannot hold the boat for late arrivals due to traffic or parking · Dock in the marina, 3-minute walk from parking at 608 River Road
